concerns.text: FR-003 uses the placeholder **[deferred]** for the discard proportion, making the requirement unverifiable. The original idea explicitly requires discarding the bottom **40 %** of videos (retain 60 %). Replace **[deferred]** with the concrete value **40 %** (or retain 60 %).

SC-001 references a target retain/discard rate as **[deferred]**, leaving the success criterion unmeasurable. The idea defines a discard rate of 40 % (retain 60 %). Update the success criterion to use the concrete 40 % discard (or 60 % retain) value.

FR-009 introduces physics‑preserving data augmentation to reach **n ≥ 64** only if the filtered set is smaller. The idea already plans to generate 1,000 videos and discard 40 %, yielding ~600 samples, so augmentation is unnecessary for the stated experiment and adds scope not requested by the idea.

FR-011 requires reporting augmentation counts and performing a sensitivity analysis, which depends on the augmentation step above. Since augmentation is not part of the original idea, this requirement over‑reaches the intended scope.

FR-020 mandates flagging the experiment if augmentation changes the mean physical‑consistency score by > 5 %. This ties directly to the unnecessary augmentation feature and therefore extends the scope beyond what the idea asked for.
